title: My Weekend
description: Practise the past simple and write about your weekend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write about your weekend in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🏖️ Last Saturday, we ___ to the beach.

exercises.explanation: Use "was" with I, he, she and it in the past.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Yesterday I ___ football with my friends. (play)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We visited my cousins on Saturday.
On Saturday we visited my cousins.
exercises.explanation: Subject + past verb + object: We visited my cousins.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: On Sunday I eated rice and fish.
answers: On Sunday I ate rice and fish.
exercises.explanation: "Eat" is irregular. The past is "ate", not "eated".

exercises.text: 🎬 ___ you watch a film last night?
exercises.explanation: Use "Did" to ask about the past.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ a picnic in the park yesterday. (have)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I did not go to school.
exercises.explanation: Subject + did not + base verb: I did not go to school.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We didn't went to the park.
answers: We didn't go to the park.
We did not go to the park.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base verb: go.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.

exercises.text: I played football ___ with my brother.
exercises.explanation: Use an adverb to say how: happily.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Who + went + what + when: Mai went shopping on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We was at my grandma's house on Sunday.
answers: We were at my grandma's house on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Use "were" with we, you and they.

exercises.text: I read a book in the morning and played games in the ___.
exercises.explanation: We say "in the afternoon" or "in the evening".

task.modelAnswer: Last weekend was great. On Saturday I went to the park with my brother Nam. We played football and ate ice cream. On Sunday I visited my grandma. She made noodles for us. I liked my weekend because it was fun.
